description: A large dome-shaped kiln of mud or clay with an orange fire glowing at its arched opening, with sparks and smoke rising. Several shirtless men in loincloths stack reddish bricks near the fire, and others carry bricks on their heads. A river with boats and palm trees sits under a sunset sky on the left, and a tall brick wall rises on the right with a figure on top. Stacks of bricks and bundles of sticks lie on the ground.
